_comment: Copy to config.json or set ARTEX_CONFIG to use another path. This file configures database and skill_dir. Use environment variables or application settings for LLM and other configuration.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. ARTEX_PG_DSN takes precedence over database in this file. Use either the individual fields below or a complete connection string in database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: To use a complete DSN, replace the database object above with the example below. A nonempty dsn takes precedence over its individual connection fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory. Each skill subdirectory contains SKILL.md. ARTEX_SKILL_DIR takes precedence over this field. Omit or leave it empty to use skills/ next to the executable. Relative paths resolve from the working directory.
